range_reason: the collection is the product: one attitude (the kid who broke every house rule and turned out fine) on oversized printed tees and cargos
audience: A 21-year-old in Delhi who still lives at home, still hears 'joote utaaro!' every evening, and grew up on BB Ki Vines.
insight: Every desi kid grew up under the same list of house rules, broke every one of them, and still swears they were raised right.
smp: Raised Right (mostly): tees for kids who broke every house rule.
device: Mummy's house rules handwritten in a list; as each one is broken, an evidence photo slaps onto a pile and the rule gets struck through in marker
device_why: the brand's name is a parent's phrase, so the reel is a desi parent's rulebook being broken one photo at a time, ending on the answer to 'ye kya pehna hai?': Raised Right

recall.what: Raised Right, Youthiapa's (Bhuvan Bam's) line of oversized printed tees and cargos
recall.does: tees and cargos for breaking Mummy's rules
recall.why: it's the desi childhood you actually had, worn loud: raised right, mostly
